elements.label: Figure 2.24: Poverty reduction, by ethnicity
elements.description:
Stacked bar chart of change in poverty rate (percentage point), y-axis from 2.0 to -15.0 with gridlines at 2.0, 0.0, -3.0, -6.0, -9.0, -12.0, -15.0. Three bars for periods 2010–2014, 2016–2020, and 2010–2020. Series (legend): Kinh (teal), Ethnic Minority (orange), Population shift effect (gray), Interaction effect (yellow). No values are printed on the bars; approximate readings are given below.

- 2010–2014 (approx. total ~-6.0): Kinh ~-4.0; Ethnic Minority ~-1.7 (cumulative bottom ~-5.7); Population shift effect ~-0.3 (bottom ~-6.0); Interaction effect ~0.
- 2016–2020 (approx. total ~-3.0): Interaction effect ~+0.2 (small, at top); Kinh ~-0.7; Ethnic Minority ~-1.5; Population shift effect ~-0.7 (bottom ~-3.0).
- 2010–2020 (approx. total ~-12.2): Interaction effect ~+0.2; Kinh ~-7.0; Ethnic Minority ~-4.6 (cumulative bottom ~-11.6); Population shift effect ~-0.5 (bottom ~-12.2).

Note printed: World Bank LMIC Poverty rates ($3.20/day 2011PPP). Source printed: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2010–2020.

The 2010–2020 bar shows the largest total reduction, driven mostly by the Kinh segment and the Ethnic Minority segment; the 2016–2020 bar is the smallest reduction, with the Kinh and Ethnic Minority contributions small and the population shift effect the largest negative component.
